sharedObjective.handling: Reuses the existing Week 1 answer without changes; source mapping remains in ob-week1-notes-audit.json.

clarifications.issue: Second Naegele example has incorrect final month/date
clarifications.handling: August 20, 2025 LMP gives May 27, 2026; both lecture examples checked against exact +280 days. Notes distinguish calendar-month shortcut from exact day arithmetic.

clarifications.issue: Probable hCG test and overly early guaranteed detection
clarifications.handling: Explains false early negatives, test instructions, serum versus urine, and need for symptoms/ultrasound to establish location and development.

clarifications.issue: Term, preterm, parity, and viability are conflated in places
clarifications.handling: Uses course GTPAL threshold 20 weeks, term ≥37+0 and preterm through36+6. Separates parity from living children and from individualized viability.

clarifications.issue: Fixed prenatal visit timetable and blanket screening statements
clarifications.handling: Identifies traditional schedule as lecture pattern, explains tailored care, urine culture, hepatitis C, test timing, repeat syphilis testing and GBS36+0–37+6.

clarifications.issue: Proteinuria alone or dilution used to dismiss abnormal findings
clarifications.handling: Preeclampsia may occur without proteinuria; severe BP/symptoms need escalation; anemia needs appropriate interpretation.

clarifications.issue: All patients with HIV said to need IV medication during labor; exposed-infant HBV follow-up misstated
clarifications.handling: HIV plan depends on viral load/treatment/adherence. HBV vaccine+HBIG within12h and PVST9–12months or after delayed completion are specified.

clarifications.issue: Movement advice permits12h delay and juice/repeated waiting; fever cutoff low/inconsistent
clarifications.handling: Reduced movement from usual prompts contact without waiting until tomorrow or relying on home Doppler; fever≥100.4F38C.

clarifications.issue: Glucose diagnostic threshold equality is ambiguous
clarifications.handling: Separates screening from100g diagnostic testing, at-or-above abnormal thresholds95/180/155/140, usually2abnormal underCarpenter–Coustan; does not mix75g criteria.

clarifications.issue: Iron/folate unit errors, fixed calorie increase, blanket diet bans
clarifications.handling: Correct mg/mcgDFE, trimester energy estimates, singletonBMIranges and current CDC/FDA food handling/fish advice.

clarifications.issue: 2024 vaccine slide and blanket medication substitutions
clarifications.handling: Uses ACOG2026 maternal schedule, Tdap eachpregnancy, eligible first maternalRSVdose32+0–36+6 seasonal, liveMMR/varicellapostpartum. Essential treatment is not abruptly stopped; anticoagulation/seizuremedication decisions require specialist review.

clarifications.issue: Amniocentesis for routine lung maturity before early delivery
clarifications.handling: Not carried forward as a routine prenatal-care service or a justification for elective early delivery; notes emphasize best established gestational age.

display: Each new objective opens to a three-bullet Quick answer, then independently collapsed topics with short bullets/labeled facts. Existing infographic, presentation disclosures, TikToks, practice, breadcrumbs, and exam-topic order are preserved.
limits: Study synthesis organized by the objectives. Automated checks verify coverage, placement, arithmetic, source integrity and rendering; these checks are not independent clinical validation.
